focus: جلسه پنجم · مالکیت با have/has got

sentences.fa: سلام از راه دور رو مي گويند (پاي تلفن، ايميل و ...)

sentences.en: I have got a flat in London.
What has she got in London?
I have got a house with a swimming pool.
What has she got in her house?
What kind of car has she got?
What kind of car have you got?
What kind of car has your father got?
I've got a lot of money in the bank.
How much money has she got?
How many children has she got?
What has she got in her house?
What kind of life has she got?
She has got a luxury life.

sentences.fa: آث و پاسم/ دست و بالم خاليه/ بي پولم

sentences.en: I haven't got a job or a house or a car.

sentences.fa: همسری ندارم و بچه ای هم ندارم.
sentences.en: I haven't got a wife and I haven't got any children.

proverb.en: A little body has got a great soul.

conversation: A: Hi there, my name is Gloria Gasto. I am an actress. I am from London; I have got a flat in London and a house in Hollywood with a swimming pool. I've got a new Rolls-Royce and a lot of money in the bank. I've got a husband and 3 wonderful children in Hollywood. Life is great. I've got everything.

B: hello, my name is Tom Atkins, I am from London too. I'm broke. I haven't got any money, I haven't got a job or a house or a car. I haven't got a wife and I haven't got any children. Life's terrible. I haven't got any thing.
